title: Monastery provisioning (dependent houses)
_note: Full clauses describing how a dependent (small) house gets by when it is not self-sufficient (see phase-15 §2.2). Each value is a complete predicate that reads after the house name ('The priory is <clause>').

entries.value: supplied by the nearest market town
fed by tithes from the surrounding farms
kept by a wealthy patron's endowment
begs its bread from passing travellers
supported by a lay brotherhood in the village
lives hand-to-mouth on what its garden yields
relies on a yearly caravan of staples
bartered for with its cheese and honey
provisioned by a charter from the local lord
fed by alms gathered on the mendicant road
sustained by rents from a distant grange
kept afloat by the sale of its copied books
dependent on a merchant guild's standing contract
carried through winter by the abbey's dwindling stores
